content:
Priya (CS): quick note — drafting a one-page runbook for low-touch customers who have bursty traffic. sanity check before i hand to AE.
Lydia (AE): yes please. can we have a 2-line TL;DR checklist for AEs? they want an easy copy. :pray:
Priya (CS): plan: TL;DR + 3 progressive sections: preflight, live-safety, recovery + tiny code snippets.
Priya (CS): preflight checklist draft: 1) confirm API key & region 2) capture expected qps and median prompt size 3) enable short telemetry retention (72h) 4) opt into burst pool if eligible
Dan (SRE): add client guidance: retry jitter 300-1200ms, circuit breaker trigger if 5xx rate > 10% over 1m. reduces cascade risk.
Priya (CS): adding under live-safety.
Sameer (PM): batching heuristic to include: if median prompt tokens < 300 -> client batching window = 100ms; else -> 30ms. keeps p95 stable.
Priya (CS): noted. also recommend prefix-caching: have clients dedupe static system prompts and send an X-Context-Id header for server-side KV reuse.
Lydia (AE): can we add a tiny example header snippet? AEs like copy-paste.
Priya (CS): snippet for fetch: ```js
fetch('/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $KEY', 'X-Context-Id': 'tenant-123:welcome' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt })
})
```
OnboardBot: reminder — attach "sample telemetry dashboard" link before publishing.
Priya (CS): monitoring section: 1) p95 latency 2) token cost / 1k requests 3) route error-rate 4) prefill hit rate (client-provided context hits).
Dan (SRE): add alert actions: p95 > 1.5s for 5m => page eng-oncall; error-rate > 5% for 10m => auto create triage ticket; prefill hit rate < 10% for 30m => notify AE for warmup.
Priya (CS): recovery playbook (quick): A) route to smaller model variant B) bump batching window + enable burst capacity C) apply temporary rate-limits to non-critical routes.
Sameer (PM): renewal-risk signals to include: sustained >20% error-rate, repeated invoice surprises (cost spikes). these should trigger high-touch outreach.
Lydia (AE): add AE pre-go-live checkbox: set billing alert thresholds.
Priya (CS): added. troubleshooting quick table (one-liners):
- latency spike -> check region routing, prefill hit rate, p95, model variant
- cost spike -> inspect token histogram, long prompts, runaway loops
- repeated 429s -> increase client concurrency cap or enforce backoff
Priya (CS): publishing as CS+AE co-branded runbook. any objections?
Lydia (AE): no objections. AE will rename to "Low-touch go-live checklist — bursty apps" in portal.
OnboardBot: publish reminder queued in 2h.
Priya (CS): thanks everyone :rocket:
